span.p:
Public surface
/auth/* · /health · /diag · /diag/boot
static assets + /_framework + SPA fallback

div.style: color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Default policy
RequireAuthenticatedUser()
schemes: Cookie (+ FakeAuth in Dev/Test)

div.style: color: rgb(10, 20, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fallback policy — default deny
RequireAuthenticatedUser(), Cookie ONLY
catches /openapi/v1.json and /scalar/v1

Second gate: feature flags
FhirExportEnabled · HandoffCoachEnabled
DriftRadarEnabled → 503 · AllowDataReset → 404

No role requirement exists anywhere:
no RequireRole, no policy with roles,
no AuthorizeView Roles=, no [Authorize(Roles=)]
